user.title: Monitor a location
user.description: Uses official NIFC wildfire and NWS alert data.

data_description.radius: Distance in miles (5–250) used for NIFC wildfire searches.

wildfire_discovered.description: Triggers when one or more monitored locations discover a nearby wildfire.
wildfire_discovered.name: Nearby wildfire discovered

wildfire_no_longer_nearby.description: Triggers when a previously observed wildfire is no longer nearby.
wildfire_no_longer_nearby.name: Wildfire no longer nearby

fire_entered_perimeter.description: Triggers when one or more monitored locations enter a reported wildfire perimeter.
fire_entered_perimeter.name: Location entered wildfire perimeter

official_alert_started.description: Triggers when one or more monitored locations receive a new official fire-related alert.
official_alert_started.name: Official fire alert started

official_alert_ended.description: Triggers when an official fire-related alert ends.
official_alert_ended.name: Official fire alert ended

threat_level_increased.description: Triggers when the wildfire threat level of one or more monitored locations increases.
threat_level_increased.name: Wildfire threat level increased

threat_level_decreased.description: Triggers when the wildfire threat level of one or more monitored locations decreases.
threat_level_decreased.name: Wildfire threat level decreased

evacuation_level_increased.description: Triggers when the evacuation level of one or more monitored locations increases.
evacuation_level_increased.name: Evacuation level increased

evacuation_level_decreased.description: Triggers when the evacuation level of one or more monitored locations decreases.
evacuation_level_decreased.name: Evacuation level decreased

source_stale.description: Triggers when a wildfire data source for one or more monitored locations becomes stale.
source_stale.name: Data source became stale

source_recovered.description: Triggers when a previously stale wildfire data source recovers.
source_recovered.name: Data source recovered
